notes: Realistic O/D pairs from Tahoe Bike Map route searches, April 2019 to October 2026 (old routing server logs; uptime monitors, scripts, QR sign scans, repeats, same-point searches and searches placed on Lake Tahoe removed; one trip per exact start and end per day; trips under 0.3 km or outside the bbox dropped). 32601 trips binned into ~1 km cells; the busiest cell pairs (at least 10 trips each) were taken per community-area pair, and each end replaced by the nearest named OpenStreetMap place (trailheads, beaches, parks and lodging first) within 0.6 km, then snapped to a bicycle edge. weight = the area pair's share of trips split over its pairs, raked so pair weights also match the real straight-line distance mix (distance_mix); share = percent of all searched trips the pair stands for. The 79 area pairs used cover 72.9% of trips. No individual searches, usage coordinates or counts are stored. purpose is inferred: recreation (a beach, trailhead or park end, or 12 km and longer) or town. Regenerate with build_usage_pairs.py in the LTBC research workspace.
attribution: Contains data from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Trip weights from aggregated Tahoe Bike Map searches, published by the Lake Tahoe Bicycle Coalition.
